description: Return the last N days of NorthPoint's signal feed: dated changes in ESMA's MiCA CASP registers (entities added to or leaving the interim register of authorised CASPs and the non-compliant entities list, read by NorthPoint from ESMA's published CSVs and kept as dated snapshots), plus corrections in NorthPoint's regulations change record. Every entry carries its date, ESMA source file and snapshot checksum.
name: get_latest_signal
